selection_rationale: Highest reviewer confidence (verdict=pass), strong novelty and falsifiability on an operationally important threat (tool‑selection and LLM‑as‑judge prompt‑injection), feasible within resource bounds, and directly addresses key unresolved risks (EF3 / UQ2).
unresolved_uncertainties: Which defenses remain robust under adaptive adversaries that iteratively probe/verifier behavior (UQ2).
Extent to which defenses generalize from simulated/minimal tool implementations to complex production toolchains and heterogeneous operator environments.
Operational tradeoffs: acceptable latency and false‑positive thresholds for real deployments and their effect on operator adoption.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Preregister an adaptive‑adversary follow‑up evaluation (iterative probing/adaptation) and include its acceptance criteria in robustness claims.
Specify full authenticated‑handoff design: signing protocol, key‑management threat model, failure modes, and measurable overheads; preregister benchmarks for key compromise scenarios.
Open‑source the attack corpus, simulated tool implementations, defense code, and exact metrics; preregister acceptable latency and false‑positive thresholds with operational justification.
